source.title: Fay - Colorful Dancer
source.name: Fay
source.description: A Support who wields an ancient gemstone that can enhance allies over a large area.

skills.name: Vibrant Dance

description.raw: Fay selects a direction and casts vitality magic to frontal allies within a 3-tile arc, restoring 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) HP and increasing their ATK by 12% for 8s.
active: Fay selects a direction and casts vitality magic to frontal allies within a 3-tile arc, restoring 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) HP and increasing their ATK by 12% for 8s.

text: Increases the ATK of allies within range by 14%.
Increases the ATK SPD of allies within range by 15.

skills.description_lite: Fay enhances and heals allies within range.

description.raw: Fay heals the weakest allied hero, restoring 50% (ATK-based) HP per second for 4 + 1.5 (SP-based)s.
active: Fay heals the weakest allied hero, restoring 50% (ATK-based) HP per second for 4 + 1.5 (SP-based)s.

text: Increases HP restored per second to 55% (ATK-based).
Increases HP restored per second to 60% (ATK-based).
Increases HP restored per second to 65% (ATK-based).

skills.name: Blinding Light

description.raw: Fay smacks a gem at an enemy. She causes an explosion when the skill hits, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies and restoring 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) HP to all allies within range.
active: Fay smacks a gem at an enemy.
She causes an explosion when the skill hits, dealing 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies and restoring 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) HP to all allies within range.

text: Increase damage to 155% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) and HP restored to 155% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based).
The gem has 2 forms and 2 different buffs.
It becomes a ruby if the target deals physical damage, reducing enemies' Phys DEF by 10% and increasing allies' Phys DEF by 10% for 5s.
It becomes a Sapphire if the target deals magic damage, reducing enemies' Magic DEF by 10% and increasing allies' Magic DEF by 10% for 5s.
Increase damage to 160% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) and HP restored to 160% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Fay smacks a gem, damaging enemies and healing allies in range.

skills.name: Grand Entrance

description.raw: Fay grants the buffs of Vibrant Dance and Healing Gemstones on the allied hero deployed 1 tile in front when a battle starts.
active: Fay grants the buffs of Vibrant Dance and Healing Gemstones on the allied hero deployed 1 tile in front when a battle starts.

text: Also increases the allied hero's Vitality by 15 till the end of a battle.
Increases the allied hero's Vitality by 20.
Increases the allied hero's Vitality by 25.

skills.description_lite: Fay enhances and heals the ally deployed on the tile in front of herself when the battle starts.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When an ally's HP ratio drops below 50% for the first time during Healing Gemstones takes effect, Fay heals the ally by 200% (ATK-based) HP. This effect can only be triggered once each time this skill is used.
active: When an ally's HP ratio drops below 50% for the first time during Healing Gemstones takes effect, Fay heals the ally by 200% (ATK-based) HP.
This effect can only be triggered once each time this skill is used.

skills.description_lite: Fay grants a low-HP ally powerful healing once when Healing Gemstones takes effect.
